description: Multi-repo registry for Council-driven patch alignment across the Luma webOS launcher ecosystem.

steve_spivak_luma_webos_launcher.notes: Arena working branch. PR #2 blocked on Rust compilation gates (no Rust toolchain in sandbox). Council framework applied (arena_guard, omni_cortex, evo_cortex, nexus_agent_os, tool_latent_codec, aegis_bug_hunter, docs/xray KB).

funnymataleao_luma_webos_launcher.notes: Native Rust + OpenGL ES webOS TV launcher. Base of our working branch. 5 commits on main, ~2 weeks old (Oct 2026). Upstream of our base commit.

ecklf_lg_luma.notes: Original upstream Luma project (LG webOS TV launcher with live video wallpapers, widgets, Jellyfin, Moonlight, Home Assistant). Releases: v2.19.0 latest, v2.18.1, v2.18.0, v2.17.0 tracked.

v2.19_features: open Luma Home early on webOS 5/6 cold boot (#88)

highlight hovered navigation tab for pointer input (#202)
keep SDL text input off until needed (webOS)

app_id_divergence.divergence: naming convention differs; no direct conflict but different app-id scheme
app_id_divergence.action: keep space.nuvio.lab isolated; never adopt com.ecklf.luma for production target

feature_gating_divergence.ecklf: feature flags via TypeScript/web build; no Rust feature flags
feature_gating_divergence.steve: nuvio_lab Cargo feature gate for isolated test target
feature_gating_divergence.divergence: different feature-gating mechanism (web build vs Cargo feature)
feature_gating_divergence.action: no patch port required; document mechanism difference

renderer_iflet_guard_divergence.ecklf: TypeScript renderer; no Rust if-let guards
renderer_iflet_guard_divergence.steve: Rust renderer with if-let guard pattern (blocked on Rust 1.93 CI pin)
renderer_iflet_guard_divergence.action: no patch port required; Rust CI toolchain gate remains blocked

lckv_seqlock_divergence.steve: LC-KV consumer read-only with strict header/card/trailer/enforcement

launch_guard_divergence.steve: isolated lab target space.nuvio.lab; no root; no production modification
launch_guard_divergence.divergence: ecklf requires root; steve explicitly forbids root and production modification
launch_guard_divergence.action: fundamental architectural divergence; do not port launch guard

ci_rust_toolchain_divergence.steve: Rust CI; pin may be too old (1.93 fails on if-let guards, needs 1.96+)
ci_rust_toolchain_divergence.divergence: ecklf has no Rust CI; steve blocked on Rust gates
ci_rust_toolchain_divergence.action: no patch port required; Rust compilation gates pending local macOS agent

alignment_rules.never_modify_production_app_id: space.nuvio.webos must never be modified/launched/replaced by Luma in any repo
alignment_rules.lab_target_isolated: space.nuvio.lab only used when nuvio_lab feature + lab=true
alignment_rules.no_silent_runtime_override: Invalid app IDs fail validation; no silent override of production app ID
alignment_rules.rollback_safe: Rollback requires no production Nuvio application modification
alignment_rules.no_duplicate_routing: No extra media launcher or duplicate routing layer
alignment_rules.receipt_required: Every cross-repo patch carries a tamper-evident RCPT receipt
alignment_rules.docs_sync: Code changes in any repo require docs/xray/ sync in the same commit
